verdict.rationale: Linear documents that its public GraphQL API is the same API it uses internally to build its own apps, which is a strong first-party signal of UI/API parity. It backs this with full schema introspection and a published SDL, an explorable Apollo Studio schema, a typed SDK, file uploads, webhooks, OAuth and API keys, and agents that act like workspace users. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or coverage map confirming every UI feature (e.g. Linear Agent coding sessions, Loops, skills) is reachable via the API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.
